correctness.rationale: All nontrivial covering transformations shift a lattice vertex by at least L, so every length less than \(L\) loop is surface-null and every four-cycle bounds exactly one unit square. Therefore \(A_2=A_3\) are free of rank \(L^2+1\), \(A_4\) through \(A_{L-1}\) are the torus/Klein surface groups, and the two explicit length-L winding loops normally generate the groups. Over \(\mathbb F_2\) the \(L^2\) square boundaries have exactly the single all-face relation; both independent winding classes die at L, proving the full persistence claim. Direct checker replay passed for \(L=5,6,7,8,9\), including exhaustive short-cycle checks for \(L=5,6,7\). All-L proof does not depend on finite tests.

value.rationale: A natural infinite family of two distinct four-regular surface square-grid systems has identical complete \(\mathbb F_2\) relation-length persistence modules but different intermediate fundamental groups. This precisely quantifies the failure of an entire binary barcode to retain nonabelian information, strengthening the motivating one-scale examples. The formula includes all death multiplicities and group stages; no claim is made about equal integral homology.
